ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We understand your concern about the rusting on the flavorizer bars. It is normal for them to develop surface corrosion or rust due to their exposure to high heat and food drippings, and as long as they haven’t developed any holes or cracks in them, they should work just fine. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to our Consumer Care team if the flavorizer bards have developed any holes or cracks, and we will be more than happy to assist you with the replacement. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I'm very happy with the overall performance of this grill. However, I was surprised to find that the flavorizer bars rusted out in just over two years. Although I'm aware the warranty for this part is two years and has expired, I'm disappointed they didn't last longer, especially since I've been diligent about covering the grill with a Weber grill cover after every use. I'd appreciate it if you could let me know if there are any options for a replacement or a discount on new bars.
Results.Title: Nice but started rusting earlier than expected.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent support to rehab my Spirit after 11 years of steady use. I changed out the left side panel, the base, and the rear panel due to corrosion despite keeping covered year round. Weber furnished all the parts, to include the bits and fasteners, as well as complete instructions, so it was a piece of cake to make the grill as good as new. One lower screw was frozen so had to use a Dremel cut-off to remove it completely.  At the same time, while the grill was disassembled, I accomplished all the annual maintenance instructions so all is well.  The delivery on the parts took less than a week and came FEDEX all perfectly wrapped and cushioned; couldn't have been better.  Thanks for the help from Weber Support.
Results.Title: Spirit Rehab to Perfection

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback and we apologize for the disappointment with the surface corrosion on your grill. Florida weather can be hard on stainless steel. However, with a bit of regular maintenance, your grill will look great for many years to come!

If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area or if chlorine is present in your environment additional maintenance will be needed to prevent rust and keep up the appearance of the exterior stainless steel parts. Below are a couple of helpful tips:

1.  At the first sign of staining, discoloration, or surface rust we recommend cleaning with a stainless steel cleaner, such as Bar Keeper's Friend to remove the rust, followed by the Weber Stainless Steel Polish to preserve the shine. Continue to use the stainless steel polish periodically to keep your grill looking its best.

2.  Once a week we recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.  This will remove any harmful salt or chemicals from the grill’s exterior.

3.  We suggest only covering your grill in the event of inclement weather. 

Your satisfaction is very important to us! Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care
